notes.title: Milestone Summer Sale
notes.content:
Speed, Sunlight and Great Deals: these are the ingredients of the Milestone Summer Sale!

Check out our wide catalogue! You’ll find what you are looking for, whether you want to set a new lap record by riding a MotoGP prototype beast or join a two-wheel challenge on the bike you own in real life. If that’s not your vibe, you can jump into the mud and feel the adrenaline with our offroad games either taming a motocross motorcycle or driving a rally car!

Ain’t no summer without racing!

notes.title: MXGP2019 - New patch released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229240/f943f3fefc2edcf61cd1e13c1dc026c0356d8f0a.gif[/img]

Here we are again with a new patch. It fixes some bugs of the game like the official team bikes audio while playing as a custom rider and some minor bugs on online spectator mode.
But let's move on to the most important improvement of this patch: the "too fast" error on time attack is finally fixed.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - New Patch Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229240/8d59c5b2525d8cd562ec2a4804891f517aa5dd96.png[/img]

Hi rider, we just have released a new patch and we're pretty sure you'll love it. 😁🤞
Thanks to your suggestions we have finally increased the maximum number of Waypoints that can be positioned from 20 to 100, but there is much more:
- New Custom Tracks online voting on Private Match.
- Tweaked bike physics in order to reduce understeering and sliding effects.
- Fixed Mitchell Evans nationality.
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash when exiting from a Custom Track race after the Online Races.
- Fixed Thor Radial boots issues.
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - New patch available
notes.content:
Hi Riders,

finally a new update is came out and we are pretty sure you will look forward to downloading it. 

The new patch improves the MXGP 2019 gaming experience even further, introducing some important features, strongly expected from the community…

As promised, the Palembang track is now available, we have all missed it, but now you can finally compete in this new track. Another important newness is coming: the introduction of a new scenario, available for the Track Editor, we can finally welcome the new Pacific environment!

For those who love challenges, you will be glad to know that online qualifications and Custom Tracks in private online lobbies are now available.

Below you will find the complete changelog of this patch note.

– Added MXGP of Indonesia (new Palembang track).

– Added Pacific as a new environment for the Track Editor.

– Added Custom Tracks to online private lobbies.

– Added online qualifications.

– Improved overall game stability.

– Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/7ae2b0fb5e78304704de162735fa367184fd7c58.gif[/img]

For the first time in the series, MXGP 2019 will allow players to step into a professional rider’s boots in the current MXGP season, to race in the Championship with all riders, bike and teams of the 2019 seasons. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ysiqcGlsnjw&feature=youtu.be

All 3D models of bikes and riders have been accurately recreated in any single detail thanks to the latest scanning technologies that ensure an unrivaled realism. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/3e920e9a295c37ec2f3980987821f233bedfaaa7.png[/img]

The current season it’s not the only new feature in MXGP 2019; for the first-time in the franchise history, players will have a Track Editor to create their favorite track fully customized with specific Motocross modules. But that’s not all! They can also select different environments where to set the track, all with different features like woods, desert, riviera and other available after launch. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/a1b411a373c4637a08d06e03271444ac064b71dc.png[/img]

Tracks created by players can be shared with the community to compete with them! 
Milestone introduces in MXGP 2019 a brand-new game mode, the Waypoint. Set inside the new Playground, where players can roam freely, it will allow players to design their own off-road path, putting checkpoints on the ground, to race them across to set the best lap. Then, players can share their creation to challenge the Community.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - Features Unveiled
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/172fbcbc74632b025c4712f8edf4329fa8a4842a.jpg[/img]

Two long awaited features of MXGP 2019 are today unveiled: the Track Editor and a brand-new game mode, The Waypoint!

[h1]TRACK EDITOR[/h1]
For the first-time in the MXGP history, you will have a Track Editor to create your favorite track fully customized with specific Motocross modules. But that’s not all! You can also select different environments where to set the track, all with different features like woods, desert, riviera and other available shortly after the D1. And share your tracks with your friends to compete with them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/cbc2b226ef91873ecfd59dc033b63bfbfe9a9a3e.jpg[/img]


[h1]WAYPOINT[/h1]
Set inside the Playground, where players can freely roam, the Waypoint will allow you to design your own off-road path, putting checkpoints on the ground, to race them across to set the best lap. Then, you can share your creation to challenge the Community! Endless user generated challenges, to find out who’s the king of the Playground!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/e7c7e3901cc4556936e3cf3dde44a1ed52649710.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iZ7wHXYUqS0
Globally available from August 27th on PlayStation®4, Xbox One and Windows PC®/STEAM, MXGP 2019 will allow you to race with all riders, bikes and teams of the current season at the tracks of the 2019 calendar.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 - Track Editor
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/66e5207be18f1c84e73c2b4539950036f26e7d96.jpg[/img]

Is your desire for challenges uncontainable? Then you will be happy to discover one of the newest features that you will find in the next MXGPvideogame.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IH-pWZld_uE

This year, MXGP 2019 will feature a brand-new Track Editor, so the players will be able to create their favorite track fully customized with specific Motocross modules.

All players will be able to share the tracks created with the Track Editor with the community and compete with them!
Players can also select 4 different environments where to set the track, all with different features: forest, beach, desert, and jungle. Tracks created by players can be shared with the other players to challenge them.

notes.title: MXGP 2019 – FIRST GAMEPLAY – GAJSER PIETRAMURATA
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35229240/3a1fdbac4e06d2a7ee8967b33ac4a3209a8011e1.gif[/img]

MXGP The Official Motocross Videogame is proud to announce its first adrenaline-fueled gameplay video of MXGP 2019, showing Tim Gajser rolling the Italian hard pack ground of Pietramurata on his Honda HRC.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_3ghSVqV7iM

Together with the new gameplay videos, Milestone also announces physical pre orders availability from June 19th and in game bonus; all players pre ordering the game will receive the exclusive Ultimate Fury Pack, two different rider sets made of  helmet, goggles, gear and boots and two animated bike liveries with frost and lightning effects.

Globally available from August 27th on PlayStation®4, Xbox One and Windows PC®/STEAM, MXGP 2019 will allow players to race with all riders, bikes and teams of the current season at the tracks of the 2019 calendar. Players will be able to compete in the MX2 category or directly in the MXGP top class, choosing either joining an official team or signing with a sponsor to race for a custom team. Finally, all the fans of the game will be able to live the thrill of the Championship at the same time of their favorite champions! MXGP 2019 will also feature a brand-new Track Editor so the players will be able to create their favorite track fully customized with specific Motocross modules. The players will be able to share the tracks created with the Track Editor with the community and compete with them!

Discover all news on our official website: https://mxgpvideogame.com/
